tasks.title: Conversation #54
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I bought a traditional recipe book and started learning how to bake.
Man: That sounds great. How has it been going so far?
Woman: Well, with mixed success, my chocolate cake turned out fabulous, But my cookies, well, let's say I'm not going to have anyone try them. I managed to eat a couple, but only because I have strong teeth.
Man: You'll do better next time.
Woman: I hope so. In fact, I'm going to try again tonight. I'm headed to the store right now to get some extra flour and sugar.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply about her cookies?

options.B: They were baked based on a new recipe.

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 女士暗示她的饼干是什么样的？属于推断题。 定位原文: “Well, with mixed success, my chocolate cake turned out fabulous, But my cookies, well, let's say I'm not going to have anyone try them. I managed to eat a couple, but only because I have strong teeth.” 选项分析: A. “They included some chocolate.”（它们包含了巧克力。）她提到巧克力蛋糕，但没有说饼干中有巧克力，因此A选项错误。 B. “They were baked based on a new recipe.”（它们是基于新食谱烤制的。）她并没有提到使用新食谱，因此B选项错误。 C. “They ended up too hard.”（它们做得太硬了。）她提到饼干太硬，只能自己吃，因此C选项正确。 D. “They were sugar-free.”（它们是不含糖的。）她并没有提到饼干是否含糖，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the woman do next?

options.B: Give the man some chocolate cake

questions.analysis: 答案: C 题目问的是: 女士接下来会做什么？属于预测题。 定位原文: “I’m headed to the store right now to get some extra flour and sugar.” 选项分析: A. “Read her recipe book.”（读她的食谱书。）没有提到她要做这件事，因此A选项错误。 B. “Give the man some chocolate cake.”（给男士一些巧克力蛋糕。）她提到饼干，而不是巧克力蛋糕，因此B选项错误。 C. “Buy some ingredients.”（买些原料。）她明确表示将去商店买面粉和糖，因此C选项正确。 D. “Call a store.”（打电话给商店。）原文没有提到打电话，因此D选项错误。
